description: This PHP class, UserRoleManagerFactory, provides factory methods for obtaining and managing instances of AbstractUserRoleManager, utilizing a service to retrieve or create these instances. It incorporates singleton pattern logic and methods to refresh the manager instance when session details change.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerFactory
classes.description: Provides static factory methods to retrieve and update instances of AbstractUserRoleManager, managing singleton pattern logic within the authorization module.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of AbstractUserRoleManager, creating it via the UserRoleManagerService if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getNewUserRoleManager
methods.description: Obtains a new instance of AbstractUserRoleManager from the service, to be used when session details change.

methods.name: updateUserRoleManager
methods.description: Refreshes the singleton user role manager instance by fetching a new one from the service after session updates.
